title: The Mentions switch holds for every mention, and order notices open the order list

source.ref: Unwired-things scan 2026-11-18 (project thread: Verify every feature path end to end); owner: full approval to make it all right

detail:
Two bell writers inserted type mention rows with no gate (the Circle-mate nudge in lib/circles/social-fuel.ts and the steward note in app/(main)/outreach/actions.ts), so a member with Mentions off still got both. A reply that @mentioned the post author skipped the reply notice even when the author had Mentions off, so they got nothing. A refund notice (reference_type order) fell back to /feed. Fixed: both writers check the in-app Mentions gate, the reply notice steps aside only when the mention can land, order opens /orders, and the router comment that said no mention emitter exists is corrected.

DONE 2026-11-18.

verify.note: Passes while the consequence in the title holds.
